title: Asymptotically Safe Gravitational Form Factors from the Proper-Time Flow Equation
summary: We study the renormalization group flow of nonlocal form factors in four-dimensional quantum gravity within the proper-time formalism at quadratic order in the curvature expansion. We show that, in the presence of a running Newtonian coupling and a fixed negative cosmological constant, the flow equations can be integrated down to $k=0$, allowing the reconstruction of the full momentum dependence of the form factors.
